name: Degree-2 polynomials, Gauss-Lobatto values, Lax-Friedrichs with a = 2 > max|f'| = 1 on u_t + u_x = 0
source: Zhang and Shu, J. Comput. Phys. 229 (2010), (2.1)-(2.6), Theorem 2.2; the Lax-Friedrichs flux h(u, v) = (f(u) + f(v) - a (v - u))/2 for f(u) = u, a = max|f'| = 1; here a = 2, not max|f'|

reconstruction.update: ubar - lam*((u0r + up1l)/2 - (up1l - u0r) - ((um1r + u0l)/2 - (u0l - um1r)))

claims.why: update = (1/6 - lam/2) u0l + 2/3 u0c + (1/6 - 3 lam/2) u0r + lam/2 up1l + 3 lam/2 um1r; the smallest bound is lam <= 1/9
the weight 1/6 - 3 lam/2 of u0r is negative for lam > 1/9
